description: A source.retire card never proposes a bare drop; it always carries at least one replacement candidate on the same card.

rubric.criterion: Card kind is a retire card
rubric.condition: card_kind equals the literal string source.retire.
The literal key retiring_source_url appears in the output.

rubric.criterion: At least one replacement candidate present
rubric.condition: The candidates array carries at least 1 item even on a retire card — the replacement, never a bare drop.
